lines: Stop, this drifting air — I'm just carrying a contradiction
Even if I start now at full speed
There's no way I'll catch up — mayday

Putting on a public face, I let it pass me by again

What's wrong — I can't afford to hope anymore
So I wait, still, for that moment

A dream that never ends
